description: A company is renewing a software contract. The vendor has increased prices by 20%. The user needs to find leverage (e.g., competitor quotes, usage data) to bring the price down.

fact_sheet.fact: The current contract with QuantumLeap Analytics is identified by agreement number IS-QLA-2021-48B.
The current 3-year contract term began on August 1, 2021.
The current contract expires on July 31, 2024.
The current annual cost for the 'Synapse BI Suite' software is $120,000.
The proposed annual cost for renewal is $144,000.
The proposed renewal cost represents a 20% price increase over the current contract.
The contract provides for 150 'Professional Tier' user licenses.
The contract's auto-renewal clause was disabled on June 5, 2024, by Alex Chen.
The software vendor is QuantumLeap Analytics, located at 123 Tech Valley Rd, San Jose, CA 95134.
The primary account manager at QuantumLeap Analytics is Sarah Jenkins.
Sarah Jenkins' email address is s.jenkins@quantumleap-analytics.com.
The direct phone number for Sarah Jenkins is +1-415-555-0182.
In the last 90 days, only 82 of the 150 licensed users have logged into the Synapse BI Suite.
The 'Predictive Forecasting Module,' an add-on accounting for 30% of the license cost, was used by only 5 unique users in the last quarter (Q2 2024).
The average number of reports generated per active user per month is 4.2.
Innovate Solutions Inc. filed 12 support tickets with QuantumLeap in the last 12 months; 3 were classified as 'High' priority.
The average resolution time for 'High' priority tickets in the last 12 months was 72 hours, exceeding the 48-hour SLA defined in contract section 8.2.
A formal quote was received from competitor 'DataWeave Pro' on June 15, 2024.
The DataWeave Pro quote for 150 equivalent licenses is $110,000 annually, with a 3-year price lock guarantee.
The DataWeave Pro platform includes a native, real-time integration with Salesforce, a feature Synapse BI Suite lacks.
A budget estimate from competitor 'InsightSphere' for a similar service tier is $98,000 annually, valid until August 30, 2024.
The primary user department for Synapse BI Suite is the Marketing Analytics team, led by Maria Garcia.
In an email dated June 10, 2024, Maria Garcia stated that the software is 'valuable but not irreplaceable at the proposed new price point'.
David Lee, a Senior Data Analyst, is the designated power user and has trained 15 other employees on the platform.
12 licenses assigned to the Finance department have shown zero login activity for over 180 days.
The internal project code for a potential migration to a new BI platform is 'Project Phoenix'.
The CIO's office has estimated the one-time internal cost to migrate to a new platform at $25,000, covering training and data porting.
The budget for this renewal is allocated under General Ledger Code 7420-Software-Subscriptions.
The maximum approved budget increase for any single software renewal in the current fiscal year (FY2025) is 7%.
The total 3-year cost impact of the 20% increase would be an unbudgeted expense of $72,000.
The renewal notice with the 20% price increase was received via email from Sarah Jenkins on June 1, 2024, at 10:15 AM PST.
The last Quarterly Business Review (QBR) with QuantumLeap Analytics was held via Zoom on April 5, 2024.
In the April 5, 2024 QBR, QuantumLeap Analytics product manager, Ken Sato, promised a 'real-time data dashboard' feature for Q2 2024, which has not been delivered.
The procurement manager leading this negotiation for Innovate Solutions Inc. is Alex Chen.
Alex Chen's negotiation mandate from the CFO is to secure a renewal price at or below a 5% increase over the current contract value.
The QuantumLeap Analytics contract being renewed is specifically for the vendor's 'Synapse BI Suite' software package.

user_needs.description: What is the current annual cost of our QuantumLeap Analytics contract for Synapse BI Suite, and what is the proposed renewal cost?
What is the percentage price increase for the proposed renewal?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After learning the new and old price, the user will want to know the exact percentage increase.

user_needs.description: When does the current contract expire?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Understanding the contract costs naturally leads to confirming the deadline for the negotiation.

user_needs.description: What is my negotiation mandate from the CFO regarding a price increase?
Out of our 150 licenses, how many users have actually logged in over the last 90 days?
Which department has 12 licenses that have shown zero activity for over 180 days?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After seeing general under-utilization, the user will want specific examples of non-usage.

user_needs.description: What is the annual cost quoted by the competitor DataWeave Pro for an equivalent service?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After establishing the vendor's price increase, the most logical next step is to find out what competitors charge.

user_needs.description: What is the budget estimate from the other competitor, InsightSphere?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After getting one competitor quote, the user would naturally ask for any others available.

user_needs.description: How many users have used the 'Predictive Forecasting Module' in the last quarter?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After identifying general license under-utilization, an intelligent assistant can proactively surface data about specific, expensive modules that are also under-utilized.

user_needs.description: What was the vendor's average resolution time for high-priority tickets, and did it meet the SLA?
Was the 'real-time data dashboard' feature promised for Q2 2024 ever delivered?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: Following an SLA breach, the user is likely to inquire about other vendor performance failures, such as broken promises.

user_needs.description: Does the competitor DataWeave Pro offer a native Salesforce integration?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After providing a competitor's price, proactively highlighting a key feature advantage that the current vendor lacks is a high-value next step.

user_needs.description: What is the primary internal stakeholder's position on renewing at the proposed new price?
What is the estimated one-time internal cost to migrate to a new platform?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Knowing that the key stakeholder is willing to switch platforms, the immediate follow-up question is about the financial implication of making that switch.

user_needs.description: Who is my account manager at QuantumLeap Analytics and what is their contact information?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After assembling all key pieces of leverage (cost, usage, competitors, performance, internal readiness), the final action is to get the contact info to begin the negotiation.
